name: ARCHIVED_NYPD Shooting Incident Data (Historic)
description:
This archived dataset contains records of shooting incidents reported by the New York City Police Department, with 5,000 sampled rows and 21 columns. Each row represents a shooting incident and includes the date and time it occurred, the borough (Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, or Staten Island), precinct, and whether the incident took place inside or outside. Location details include a classification such as street, housing, dwelling, or commercial, along with a more specific location description, coordinates, latitude and longitude, and a geocoded point for mapping.

Incident records also indicate whether the shooting was classified as a statistical murder, and provide demographic details for both perpetrators and victims where known, including age group, sex, and race. Perpetrator fields have notable missing values (about 10% overall, with a large share recorded as null), while victim demographics are complete.
